_readme: Cases that are known to fail and should NOT block CI.
Each entry needs a reason and a TODO. An entry without a plan to remove it is
how a suite quietly stops testing anything -- the failure becomes furniture.
A case listed here still runs and still appears in the report under 'Known
failures'; it just does not fail the build. Remove the entry when the
underlying issue is fixed, and CI will start guarding it again.
Populate after triaging the first run. Empty means every failure blocks.
